signals.title: @CSIS: India has disclosed its first cyber incident carried out by an AI agent rather than a human. How New Delhi and Washington respond is an earl
signals.content: India has disclosed its first cyber incident carried out by an AI agent rather than a human. How New Delhi and Washington respond is an early test of whether they can manage frontier AI risk together, write @CSISIndiaChair experts Aman Thakker and Aditya Goswamy. Read: https://t.co/7mEB4MMW1I
signals.score_reason: Twitter/X discussion signal; agentic AI relevance. Final score: 76. Freshness: source age 0.25d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: @CSIS: India reports its first AI‑driven cyber incident. The episode tests how New Delhi and Washington will coordinate on frontier AI risk. India confirmed an intrusion attributed to an autonomous AI agent, not a human operator. Both governments are evaluating attribution, mitigation, and policy frameworks, but details remain limited. The case highlights emerging challenges in attribution, legal accountability, and joint response mechanisms for AI‑enabled threats.
Source: https://t.co/7mEB4MMW1I
signals.brief_ar:
العنوان: @CSIS: الهند تكشف عن أول حادثة إلكترونية نفذها وكيل ذكاء اصطناعي وليس إنسانًا. تُعدّ هذه الحالة اختبارًا مبكرًا لقدرة نيودلهي وواشنطن على إدارة مخاطر الذكاء الاصطناعي المتقدمة معًا. أكدت الهند وقوع اختراق يُعزى إلى وكيل ذكاء اصطناعي مستقل، وتُجري الحكومتان تقييمًا للاعتبار، والحد من الأضرار، وإطار السياسات، لكن التفاصيل لا تزال محدودة. تُظهر الحالة التحديات الناشئة في تحديد المصدر، والمسؤولية القانونية، وآليات الاستجابة المشتركة للتهديدات المدعومة بالذكاء الاصطناعي.
المصدر: https://t.co/7mEB4MMW1I

signals.title: SachiK0thari/agentpay-procurement
signals.content: AI procurement agent on Stripe Issuing, built so the LLM can't move money. Deterministic policy, budget and real-time authorization checks sit between it and payment. A 74-scenario eval suite shows 0 unsafe purchases, 17/17 adversarial attacks blocked, and 0 duplicate charges under crashes and retries.
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance; large language model relevance. Final score: 68. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: SachiK0thari/agentpay-procurement

An AI procurement agent integrated with Stripe Issuing, designed so the language model cannot directly transfer funds. A deterministic policy layer enforces budget limits and real‑time authorization checks before any payment request reaches Stripe. Evaluation across 74 scenarios recorded zero unsafe purchases, blocked all 17 adversarial attacks, and showed no duplicate charges even under system crashes and retry conditions.
signals.brief_ar:
العنوان: SachiK0thari/agentpay-procurement

وكيل شراء مدعوم بالذكاء الاصطناعي مدمج مع Stripe Issuing، صُمم بحيث لا يتمكن نموذج اللغة من نقل الأموال مباشرة. طبقة سياسة حتمية تفرض حدود الميزانية وتحقق من التفويض في الوقت الفعلي قبل أي طلب دفع إلى Stripe. في تقييم شمل 74 سيناريو، لم تُسجَّل عمليات شراء غير آمنة، وتم حجب جميع الهجمات العدائية الـ 17، ولم تُسجَّل أي عمليات شحن مكررة حتى في حالات تعطل النظام وإعادة المحاولة.

signals.brief_en:
Title: Retsumdk/Retsumdk
Role: AI Agent Infrastructure Expert – Building the future of autonomous AI systems.
Brief: The subject specializes in designing, deploying, and scaling modular AI agent architectures that operate with minimal human oversight. Core competencies include distributed orchestration, secure data pipelines, and adaptive learning loops. Current projects focus on integrating LLMs with edge compute nodes to enable real‑time decision‑making in constrained environments. Risks involve model drift, supply‑chain vulnerabilities, and regulatory compliance gaps. Monitoring recommendations: track model performance metrics, audit data provenance, and maintain redundancy across compute layers.

signals.title: RevanParimi/StockAgent
signals.content: Multi-agent AI system for NSE automobile stock analysis. (fundamentals, sentiment, technicals, macro, policy, and more) run in parallel, fuse scores via a weighted signal aggregator, and deliver a structured BUY/SELL verdict. Features adaptive RL weight learning — the system gets smarter with every prediction it reviews.
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance. Final score: 58. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: RevanParimi/StockAgent
A multi‑agent AI platform that analyses NSE automobile stocks across fundamentals, sentiment, technicals, macro‑economics, policy and other factors. Agents run in parallel, their outputs are fused by a weighted signal aggregator that produces a structured BUY/SELL recommendation. The aggregator’s weights are adjusted by reinforcement‑learning, allowing the system to improve as it reviews its own predictions. The brief reflects current open‑source intelligence and acknowledges inherent uncertainty in market forecasts.

Title: cassiomc1/ai-agent-terminal-monitor
Universal, autonomous watcher and safe continuation driver for any AI coding agent CLI (Claude Code, OpenCode, Aider, Goose, etc.) running in Terminal.app, iTerm2, or tmux.
